senses.sense_definition: A historic coastal city in Sicily, Italy, known for its rich Greek and Roman history.

examples.text: The ancient mathematician Archimedes lived and died in <w>Syracuse</w>.

target_lang_translations.nl: De antieke wiskundige Archimedes leefde en stierf in <w>Syracuse</w>.

examples.text: During our summer vacation in Sicily, we spent three days exploring <w>Syracuse</w>.

target_lang_translations.nl: Tijdens onze zomervakantie op Sicilië hebben we drie dagen besteed aan het verkennen van <w>Syracuse</w>.

target_lang_definitions.nl: Een historische kuststad op Sicilië (Italië), bekend om haar rijke Griekse en Romeinse geschiedenis.

senses.sense_definition: A major city in central New York State, United States.

examples.text: Many students move to <w>Syracuse</w> every year to attend college.

senses.sense_definition: Syracuse University, a private research university located in New York.

examples.text: She decided to study journalism at <w>Syracuse</w> because of its strong program.

examples.text: The basketball game between Duke and <w>Syracuse</w> was broadcast nationwide.
